quests.instruction: IDENTIFY THE TARGET CONSONANT PHONEME ENUNCIATED IN THE WORD
quests.hint: Listen for the soft, breathy voiceless dental fricative /θ/ as in 'bath'. (Calibration 1-1)
quests.explanation: The word spoken is "think". It features the distinct consonant sound /θ/.
